description.narrative: The Project has an Anticipated Impact Measurement and Monitoring (AIMM) rating of Good, based on an AIMM score of 53. On an unadjusted basis (i.e., without the likelihood factor), the full potential AIMM score could reach 64. The most significant, expected Project-level outcomes are (i) stakeholder effects on suppliers, through the purchase of goods and services from local SMEs and (ii) environmental effects via reduction in GHG emissions by improving the water and energy efficiency of the newly constructed hotel as well as greening the upcoming pipeline of projects. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates the investment to promote Integration in the Jordanian tourism sector by maintaining the operation of existing infrastructure and supporting the completion of the hotel component of an integrated tourist destination project in Aqaba, Jordan, facilitating improved access to tourism infrastructure and related services for visitors and attracting more international tourists into region.

The proposed long-term secured A-Loan of up to USD 35.5 million (the Loan) will be part of the multi-bank facility to Oasis-33 Mixed Use Development Company (the Company). The Company is a mixed-use real estate company responsible for developing, constructing, and operating Ayla Marina Village, which includes three hotels and retail stores within the Ayla development complex in Aqaba, Jordan. The Loan will be used by the Company to i) fund capital expenditure and complete the construction of a new hotel and ii) reprofile existing debt that was used to partly fund the construction of the existing two hotels and retail stores (the Project).
